en: A colorized night-time view of a grand historic city square with a large ornate neo-baroque/ringstrasse-style building dominating the scene. The building has a central dome, flanked by two smaller domes and several tall spires, with many lit windows. In front stands a statue on a pedestal and steps leading up from the square. Gas or early electric street lamps illuminate the square, where people in early-20th‑century European clothing stand and walk, and a tram can be seen further down the street. The sky is dark with a bright moon and dramatic clouds. The card edges show wear, typical of an old printed postcard. No legible text is visible on the front.
